actions.name: bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

lore:
The badger, or *Meles silvestris*, is a creature of low-slung might and subterranean stubbornness. It dwells within the shadowed roots of ancient groves, carving sprawling labyrinths known as setts. Though it appears stout, do not mistake its girth for lethargy. The badger is a relentless predator of the undergrowth, driven by a singular, bone-deep tenacity. It does not merely hunt; it besieges, using its formidable claws to unearth the hidden and its iron jaws to crush the defiant. It is whispered among woodsmen that once a badger takes hold, it will not release until the marrow itself sings.

In local folklore, the badger is the "Silent Steward of the Deep Roots." Legends claim they guard the buried secrets of the earth, and to harm one is to invite a lingering, stubborn misfortune upon one's hearth. They are the personification of the forest’s own wrath—slow to stir, but impossible to turn aside once provoked. If you encounter a badger in the gloaming, traveler, yield the path; it has lived longer in the dark than you have in the light.
